name: How long does it typically take to install a threshold ramp?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a threshold ramp?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a threshold ramp can vary significantly based on the type of ramp and the complexity of the doorway or step. Simple, pre-fabricated ramps for a single doorway might take as little as 30 minutes to an hour. Custom-fit or modular ramp systems, especially those requiring precise measurements or minor modifications to the surrounding area, could take a few hours. We always ensure a secure and stable installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically ranges from 30 minutes for simple ramps to a few hours for custom or modular systems, depending on complexity.
